## Pick, compare, keep

01 · Pick
### Point at what you want to change

Select an element and describe the outcome. Add a comment or draw a mark when it is easier to show than explain.

Newsletter card 1

02 · Generate
### Explore three alternatives

Compare different layouts, hierarchies, or levels of emphasis within your project’s identity. Tune a variation when adjustment controls are available.

No.04

Dispatch

Field

03 · Accept
### Keep the result in source

Accept the version you want. Impeccable integrates it into your project and removes temporary preview code. Discard the set to restore the original selection.

Variant 2 written to source

## A direction for the whole page

Use Steer to type or speak a request without selecting an element first. “Make the delivery information easier to find” can guide changes across the page. The agent works on the request directly.

## Get started

Works with your web project
*   bundler**Vite**
*   apps**Next.js**
*   apps**SvelteKit**
*   pages**Astro**
*   apps**Nuxt**
*   runtime**Bun**
*   static**Static HTML**

Live Mode works on web pages. It does not attach to native iOS or Android interfaces.
